paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9, folio 12b: “Rabbi Yose taught: those of Beit Chagira were expert scribes in Jerusalem,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9 reads “Rabbi Yose says: those of Beit Chagira were expert scribes in Jerusalem.” Beit Chagira is the subject of the reported statement, not an epithet identifying Rabbi Yose.

The whole consulted Guggenheimer paragraph of Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9 begins with Rabbi Yose’s statement that those of Beit Chagira were expert scribes in Jerusalem. It supports the full local title Rabbi Yose and the house as the statement’s subject. The supplied folio 12b remains Hyman’s locator; the digital passage is not a fresh collation of printed folios or proof that Chagira was Rabbi Yose’s epithet.
